confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation rates and bar prices are least certain and vary widely. FX: the newest RBA figure located is dated 13 Oct 2026 and was taken from search results; a 14 Oct figure could not be confirmed, and the RBA page was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Estimates draw on general knowledge of Florence's central tourist-zone pricing, informed by typical Rome and Venice tourist-area levels, with Bologna and Siena as lower-tier Italian references and a July peak-season premium on accommodation. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from general knowledge of Florentine bar and restaurant prices, not from a beer-ratio basis.
